typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_SCRUB_DATE as timestamp,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_JOB_NAME as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_DISPOSITION_CODE as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_ASSOCIATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_MEMBERNUMBER, CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_SCRUB_DATE, CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_JOB_NAME, CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_DISPOSITION_CODE, CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_ASSOCIATE FROM PDS_CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING DSM  WHERE DSM.CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_EXPORT_DT IS NULL AND CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_MARKET = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> CalllistMissingRecords
CalllistMissingRecords derive(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_DISPOSITION_CODE_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_DISPOSITION_CODE),
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_ASSOCIATE_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_ASSOCIATE),
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_SCRUB_DATE_Unicode = toDate(toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_SCRUB_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_MEMBERNUMBER_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_MEMBERNUMBER),
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_JOB_NAME_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_MISSING_JOB_NAME)) ~> NonUnicodetoUnicode
NonUnicodetoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> CalllistMissingFile
NonUnicodetoUnicodeNME sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> CalllistMissingFileNME
